name: workflow-modes
description: Persist and enforce discuss, plan, and execute workflow modes across long Codex sessions and context compaction.

interface.shortDescription: Keep discuss, plan, and execute modes durable.
interface.longDescription: Workflow Modes provides dormant lifecycle hooks that persist active mode metadata outside model context, restore it after compaction, and guard mutations according to the active tracker-backed workflow.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $discuss, $plan, or $execute with durable workflow-mode guardrails.
